run_export_scannet_scene: run the CLI to export a ScanNet scene mesh, labels, and bboxes to numpy files
create_function_read_aggregation: create a function that reads a ScanNet aggregation JSON and maps object IDs and labels to segments
create_function_read_segmentation: create a function that reads a ScanNet segmentation JSON and maps segment IDs to vertex indices
refactor_extract_bbox: refactor the extract_bbox function to compute axis-aligned bounding boxes from mesh vertices and instance IDs
review_export: review the export function that processes ScanNet mesh, aggregation, segmentation, and meta files into aligned vertices and labels
